points.description: States hydrolysis as a stage (breakdown of complex organics into simpler soluble compounds), named correctly.
States acidogenesis as a stage, named correctly.
States acetogenesis as a stage, named correctly.
States methanogenesis as a stage, named correctly.

rubric.notes: Full marks only if all four stages are named with the correct technical terms: hydrolysis, acidogenesis, acetogenesis, methanogenesis. Each stage earns 0.5; vague descriptions without the term (e.g. "gas production") earn nothing. A wrong extra stage (e.g. aerobic oxidation, nitrification) costs one point. Round the total to whole marks only if the marker's scheme requires it.
